title: Writing Well
tagline: Clear thinking made visible — from clean sentences to work you actually ship
curricula: University composition curricula, Zinsser's On Writing Well, Strunk & White's The Elements of Style
endpoint: from clean sentences to work you actually ship
about: Writing is clear thinking made visible — the craft of putting ideas into sentences a reader can follow without effort. This category works from the sentence up: clarity, structure, revision, and voice, toward the discipline that separates writers from people with ideas — actually finishing and shipping work.
